free_tier.stated: No free tier. Japan Rakuten dedicated is $99.99 a month: 2 CPU, 4096 MB RAM, 30 GB NVMe, a Rakuten 5G mobile primary network at 300 Mbps peak, 20 TB a month one-way (throttled above), an IPv4-only dedicated address with no inbound ports, and a secondary IPv6 network. The IPv4 is dynamic and changes when the phone network restarts, with one change a month by ticket. The product page showed 'sold out' on 2026-11-03.
free_tier.notes: The page says the machine is switched on the same working day.

retention.stated: not applicable: a rented machine and its address, not stored bytes
retention.notes: The page states the IPv4 is dynamic; no address-retention term at non-payment is stated.

egress.terms: 20 TB a month counted one-way, with speed reduced above the allowance. The 300 Mbps figure is a peak that falls when the line is congested.
egress.free_allowance: 20 TB per month (one-way) on the Rakuten 5G private room

interface_detail: A virtual dedicated server whose outbound IPv4 is a Rakuten 5G mobile line with no inbound ports; the access method is not stated on the product page.
tooling: An SSH or RDP client, whichever the image supports, plus a proxy or tunnel daemon the user installs on the machine. Inbound connections to the mobile IPv4 are not available, so the machine reaches out. The vendor publishes no proxy endpoint on the pages read.
chaining: A Worker reaches the server over its IPv6 secondary network and the server makes the upstream request over the Rakuten 5G primary line, so the upstream sees a Japanese mobile-carrier address instead of AS13335. The page says traffic comes in on the secondary network and goes out on the primary.

limits.value: 20 TB per month one-way on the Rakuten 5G private room, speed reduced above it
300 Mbps peak on the Rakuten 5G network, lower when the line is congested

limits_note: Stock decides this record: the product was sold out when read. The address is shared-carrier mobile, not a fixed consumer line: it is dynamic and one ticketed change is allowed each month.
binding_note: The 20 TB allowance is far above a low-volume exit. What decides the record is stock and the unverified registration class of the mobile carrier address.

identity_cost.detail: The registration form marks first name, last name, email, password and password confirmation as required (asterisks); phone, company, country, address and city are not marked required. Payment routes listed on the home page are crypto through two processors, Alipay QR, Revolut and Wise. Whether a card is accepted is unverified.

reliability_note: The IPv4 changes when the phone network restarts, so a session can lose its address. The home page carries an upgrade notice dated 2026-10-18 after a storefront outage.
confidence_note: Price, specification, stock and registration fields are documented from the vendor's shop pages. The registration class of the carrier address is unverified because no test address is published.
